series.name: Типографика
series.prompt:
Create a polished art-direction contact sheet of EIGHT portfolio project covers as ONE image. Exact layout: FOUR columns and TWO rows of equal landscape 4:3 cards; overall board aspect 8:3, high resolution around 3200 x 1200. Narrow consistent 18px off-white gutters, NO headings or decorative board border. All eight designs must look like one award-winning graphic design portfolio series. Direction: KINETIC EDITORIAL TYPOGRAPHY. Warm ivory #efefeb and ink black #111318, ONE restrained electric chartreuse #dfff4d accent used across ALL cards. Exceptionally refined contemporary Swiss typography with very large bold sans lettering, aggressive intentional cropping, asymmetric whitespace, editorial hierarchy. Fill 60-80% of each cover with powerful custom typographic compositions; NOT a small icon centered on empty pastel. No UI screenshots, mock browser windows, stock photography, generic AI gradients, floating colored balls, glows, or clutter. Actual flat print-like poster graphics. Make shapes and type visually interact, distinctive without becoming noisy. Typography should be accurate and beautiful. Eight projects in reading order:
1 "AMTEK" — logistics: oversized tightly kerned AM / TEK on two lines and a single rhythmic structure of long container ribs, diagonal knockout with chartreuse.
2 "dl.studio" — digital studio: giant cropped lowercase dl. and a very large solid geometric step cutting through typography.
3 "dl.games" — games: enormous playful GAMES typographic arrangement, one broad looping line woven between letters; monochrome with one lime zone.
4 "КРАСНЫЙ ПУТЬ" — creative cluster: bold Cyrillic two-line name combined with large sharp eight-ray asterisk cropping outside canvas.
5 "CREDO." — tyres: giant C with circular negative space, cropped black tyre-like concentric rhythm, sophisticated editorial typography.
6 "GDG" — data platform: giant GDG letters interrupted by a single sharply rhythmic vertical bar composition, no small UI elements.
7 "МУЖСКОЙ КЛУБ" — private club: impactful Cyrillic initials МК with a fine but large typographic membership card structure; contemporary premium NOT traditional gold branding.
8 "КОЗИХИНСКИЙ 22" — architecture: gigantic 22 with arched counter-shapes and small Cyrillic project name, sculptural typography.
Tiny consistent project-category labels at top-left and number 01 through 08 at bottom-right, but no extra text. Designs must be substantially DIFFERENT compositions while aligned in palette, visual weight, margins, and typographic family. Sophisticated, bold, memorable, minimal enough to read as one gallery.

series.name: Металл и свет
series.prompt:
Generate ONE high-end art direction contact sheet for eight portfolio project covers. EXACT grid: four columns, two rows; each cell landscape 4:3, board aspect 8:3. Thin consistent dark gutters. Image about 3200x1200, polished professional CGI art direction.
Direction: SCULPTURAL CHROME / MATERIAL STUDIES. All eight covers use precisely same graphite-black backdrop, brushed and polished silver aluminum, cool white key light, subtle electric cobalt-blue reflected edge accent. Strong dramatic silhouettes, sophisticated reflected light, seamless studio backdrop, architectural lighting, real tangible material. Every sculpture occupies 65-85% of card; very close, tightly cropped, dominant graphic silhouette, purposefully composed off-center. NOT little isolated icons. No rainbow palette, no purple gradients, no nebulae, no sci-fi HUD, no particles, no busy UI, no fake photographs, no tiny line drawings. A restrained expensive technological editorial mood. Matching scale, lighting and camera across gallery, abstractly connected to the projects, not literal product mockups.
Eight covers in reading order, names set in modest white clean sans-serif in bottom-left with consistent generous 30px margins:
1 "AMTEK": giant close-up stack of aluminum container-like folded rectangular blocks, sharp parallel ribs, dark negative gaps, strong blue edge reflection.
2 "dl.studio": enormous sculptural folded angular slab resembling two interlocking offset steps, mirror chrome face versus matte side.
3 "dl.games": a large continuous tubular knot / figure-eight loop of polished chrome, tactile fluid geometry, subtle cobalt inner glow from reflected studio light only.
4 "КРАСНЫЙ ПУТЬ": massive extruded sharp eight-ray star viewed at a sophisticated tilted angle, broad metallic faces, minimal composition.
5 "CREDO.": oversized black-chrome torus with precisely cut radial grooves, like a sculptural tire section, dramatic huge close crop.
6 "GDG": a powerful ascending stack of long polished rectangular metallic prisms with one brushed cobalt face, data as abstract architecture.
7 "МУЖСКОЙ КЛУБ": a large sculptural folded metal membership plate, one deeply engraved angular M insignia, diagonally across frame, understated prestige.
8 "КОЗИХИНСКИЙ 22": three very tall sculptural silver arches with deep shadows, tight close crop, architectural material study.
Project name captions must be spelled accurately; use only these captions, tiny 01-08 number in top-right; no other text. Entire gallery must be cohesive, minimal but striking, cinematic contemporary portfolio, professionally rendered. Make objects structurally distinct so eight frames do not look like the same chrome blob.

series.name: Оптическая графика
series.prompt:
Create ONE striking professional art-direction contact sheet of eight portfolio covers. Exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, eight equal landscape 4:3 cards, overall aspect 8:3 around 3200x1200. Thin neutral gutters. Direction: OPTICAL SYSTEMS / CONTEMPORARY TECHNOLOGICAL POSTERS. All eight use exactly same electric ultramarine cobalt blue #2147ff and white/off-white #f7f7f2; almost entirely two-tone. Optional black only for small typography. No 3D chrome (different direction), no UI screenshots, no browser windows, no stock photography, no small centered logo on pastel, no rainbow, no generic gradients, no decorative glow.
Art style: exceptional sophisticated optical graphic design, large continuous precision linework with distortion and negative-space shapes, strong graphic contrast, crisp vector-like print quality. Dramatic scale: optical structures occupy 70-90% of each card and are partially cropped beyond frame; carefully leave an intentional calm text zone. Pattern frequency visibly balanced, not tiny distracting noise. Each composition should have ONE memorable optical visual and ample intentional negative space, not collections of icons. Some cards blue ground/white lines and others white ground/blue lines, precisely balanced across contact sheet. Feel like a cohesive generative art exhibition designed by a contemporary design studio.
Eight covers in reading order, clear consistent project name in sans-serif at bottom-left, modest but readable, category at top-left:
1 AMTEK / LOGISTICS: architectural container-rib lines transform into a vast curved tunnel of perspective, white ground and blue ribs.
2 dl.studio / DIGITAL: a large sharp stepped shape revealed by vertical blue lines bending around it, blue ground with white structure, sculptural optical negative-space.
3 dl.games / PLAY: broad blue-and-white warped checkerboard ribbon forming one exuberant continuous loop, smooth graphic silhouette.
4 КРАСНЫЙ ПУТЬ / CLUSTER: huge radial eight-ray asterisk of white negative space in tightly controlled flowing blue striped field.
5 CREDO. / MOBILITY: bold optical concentric rings compressed asymmetrically like a very large spinning wheel, white-blue poster, intentional white calm wedge.
6 GDG / DATA: harmonic rhythmic column lines with a single flowing wave cut through their height, large ordered blue-white data abstraction.
7 МУЖСКОЙ КЛУБ / MEMBERSHIP: very large confident M-shaped negative space in precisely arranged white vertical lines on cobalt, more calm and premium.
8 КОЗИХИНСКИЙ 22 / ARCHITECTURE: monumental arched white negative space intersected by blue vertical columns, very large 22 positioned beside the arch.
Only exact names and category labels as above, tiny 01-08 index top-right. Accurate Cyrillic spelling. All eight must remain beautiful TOGETHER: same visual weight, same two colors, unified category and caption positioning. Bold experimental yet disciplined, minimal high-impact graphic posters, no gratuitous complexity.
